bwncr.configuration.title: %s Configuration
bwncr.configuration.general.tooltip: All Bad Wither No Cookie Reloaded settings. Full explanations are in glorious novella format in the config file comments.
bwncr.config.silenceWither.tooltip: Silences the Wither spawn and death sounds that are heard across the whole world. On by default.
bwncr.config.silenceTrader.tooltip: Silences the ambient sounds of wandering traders and llamas. On by default.
bwncr.config.silenceDragon.tooltip: Silences the Ender Dragon death sound that is heard across the whole world. On by default.
bwncr.config.silenceLightning.tooltip: Silences the thunder sound of lightning. On by default.
bwncr.config.silenceExplosion.tooltip: Silences explosion sounds, primed TNT and creeper hissing, and wind charge bursts. Off by default.
bwncr.config.silenceUs.tooltip: Sounds to silence, one per entry, for example entity.sheep.step. Find names with the listen command. Blank entries are ignored.
bwncr.config.debugMode.tooltip: Writes every intercepted sound and every silencing decision to the log. Very noisy. Off by default.
tooltip.bwncr.silence: Apply at an anvil to headwear to hear no mob or entity sounds.
tooltip.bwncr.silence_mob: Apply at an anvil to headwear to hear no sounds from this mob.
tooltip.bwncr.silence_all: Apply at an anvil to headwear to hear no sounds at all.
tooltip.bwncr.silence_group: Apply at an anvil to headwear to hear no sounds of this kind.
